name: Avoid battery charging at low temperatures
Battery check at low temperature
quote: Do not check the battery at high temperature of 65 °C (149 °F) or more or low temperatures be- low 10 °C (50 °F).

name: Battery storage upper temperature limit
quote: Do not store battery at below temperatures below -10 °C or above 60 °C.

name: Low-temperature charging reduces riding distance
value: maximum riding distance per full charge becomes shorter
quote: If the battery has been charged in a low temperature environment (0 °C or below), the maximum riding distance per full charge becomes shorter.
